objective: Reach the Global Business Elite with bp's equity story, exceeding the GBE engagement target at or below the brief cost per engagement
targeting: Global Business Elite: institutional investors, analysts, C-suite decision-makers and energy policymakers (UK)

planning_priorities.label: Quarterly results season
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Be present and visible in the two weeks around each quarterly results announcement, when investor and analyst attention on bp is highest; respect market-sensitive quiet periods beforehand.

planning_priorities.label: AGM and strategy update
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Carry the full-year results and strategy update from February through to the AGM in April, using premium video to explain strategy and capital-allocation priorities to shareholders.

planning_priorities.label: Energy conference moments
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Align activity with Davos, International Energy Week, CERAWeek, Gastech, ADIPEC and COP31, when GBE attention on energy policy and capital allocation peaks.

planning_priorities.label: GBE precision targeting
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Prioritise verified GBE inventory: financial publisher PMPs, contextual energy and markets keywords, and premium financial news CTV.

planning_priorities.label: Brand awareness and reputation
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Build awareness and favourability of bp's equity story among the GBE without a fundamental change to channel strategy.

planning_priorities.label: Channel role clarity
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Provide clarity on the roles of CTV & Streaming (premium reach), Programmatic Display (precision), Online Video (consideration) and Meta (amplification).

planning_priorities.label: Measurement framework
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Agree per-channel KPIs - view-through and frequency for CTV and video, viewability and engagement for display, reach and engagement for Meta - and validate GBE match quality with IPSOS IGI.

planning_priorities.label: US market readiness
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Structure the plan so US investment communications can be added once the US data pipeline is available via the7stars BigQuery.
